title: itshover: an open-source icon library where motion comes first  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Static icons feel dead and it hover is the fix. It hover is an open- source icon library where motion comes first, not as decoration, but as part of the design. Every icon is a fully editable React component with animation baked right in. You don't install a heavy library or lock yourself in. You just copy, paste, and customize the SVG motion directly in your
